stories.title: Room on the Gangplank
stories.blurb: Nori helps the crew find a better way aboard.

stories.title: The Crooked Captain's Flag
stories.blurb: A paint slip gives Red a chance to speak kindly to himself.

stories.title: The Tide That Brought Us Wrappers
stories.blurb: A beach clean-up leads to a bin that clicks shut.

stories.title: The Boat That Wouldn't Float
stories.blurb: Purple tests a wider ferry for a very small passenger.

stories.title: The Last Jam Star
stories.blurb: Two friends want different parts of the same biscuit.

stories.title: The Too-Loud Ahoy
stories.blurb: Blue asks for a greeting that feels good to her ears.

stories.title: The Tiny Tracks on Shell Beach
stories.blurb: Tiny footprints send a treasure hunter the long way round.

stories.title: The Map with a Hole in It
stories.blurb: A torn map leads to clues in the places Rainbow can see.

stories.title: The Knock at the Galley Door
stories.blurb: Red listens, says sorry and helps repair a mistake.

stories.title: The Captain Who Needed a Sit-Down
stories.blurb: A tired cook asks for a seat and lets the crew carry on.

stories.title: The Reef That Sang at Low Tide
stories.blurb: The crew brings back sounds and leaves shells at the reef.

stories.title: Three Tries for the Kite
stories.blurb: A rabbit kite takes off when Orange changes direction.

stories.title: The Two Ends of the Hammock
stories.blurb: Nori shows Green exactly what help they want.

stories.title: The Too-Many-Things Box
stories.blurb: Purple clears a small space and chooses one job for today.

stories.title: The Picnic with No Flying Bits
stories.blurb: Tins and a clever napkin help lunch stay out of the bay.

stories.title: The Day the Drum Went Plop
stories.blurb: A wet drum gives way to claps, steps and a sock.

stories.title: A Place for the Quiet Pirate
stories.blurb: The sound hunt makes room for watching and pointing.

stories.title: The Day Rainbow Missed Home
stories.blurb: A familiar goodnight helps Rainbow feel at home away from home.

stories.title: The Garden That Drank Slowly
stories.blurb: The crew gives six bean plants a slower drink.

stories.title: The Bridge of Little Steps
stories.blurb: Purple tries the footbridge one board at a time.

stories.title: The Race She Chose to Leave
stories.blurb: Orange listens to her body and chooses to leave a race.

stories.title: The Promise in the Tin
stories.blurb: Purple keeps a drawing safe until Blue chooses to share it.

stories.title: The Lanterns That Stayed on Land
stories.blurb: The crew lights the path and leaves the beach dark for birds.

stories.title: The Foggy Day Dock Band
stories.blurb: Fog keeps the boats docked, so Blue brings the reef indoors in sound.

stories.title: The Rainy Boots Day
stories.blurb: Green gives herself time to feel sad about a cancelled walk.

stories.title: The Treasure Chest with Two Keys
stories.blurb: Orange and Wren find a fair way to use both keys.

stories.title: The Sail That Got a Second Voyage
stories.blurb: A worn sail becomes shade without losing its patches.

stories.title: The Great Pancake Flip
stories.blurb: A cloth, a smaller pan and some practice help Gold find his flip.

stories.title: The Little Red Help Flag
stories.blurb: Red asks for the hand he needs and asks sooner the next time.

stories.title: The Bell That Fell Silent
stories.blurb: Rainbow keeps Pearl company as she remembers an old bell.

stories.title: The Race Past the Reed Beds
stories.blurb: Orange keeps the rowing course away from a quiet duck nursery.

stories.title: The Arch That Took Two Days
stories.blurb: Green comes back the next day to build a steadier arch.

stories.title: Blue's Very Small Treasure
stories.blurb: Blue chooses the treasure she loves, even though it fits in one hand.

stories.title: The Pirate Who Polished the Stars
stories.blurb: Gold notices Nori’s work and asks how they’d like it acknowledged.

stories.title: The Bucket That Kept Saying Plip
stories.blurb: A drip leads to a repaired tap and a drink for dry pots.

stories.title: The Night the Lanterns Went Out
stories.blurb: When seven lights go out, the crew finds one useful thing to practise.

stories.title: One Morning for Captain Green
stories.blurb: Green keeps a morning for herself and enjoys the sunrise.

stories.title: The Joke That Went Too Far
stories.blurb: Red speaks up when a joke hurts Wren and checks what they want.

stories.title: The Treasure That Fed the Soil
stories.blurb: The crew discovers what happened to its saved fruit scraps.

stories.title: The Parade With No Wind
stories.blurb: A windless evening gives the crew a new way to hold the parade.
